note: Planted API issues. Match by file + issue; line +-3 counts (spec or handler line both count). Decoys must NOT be reported. No hint comments in the target this time.

vulns.title: jwt.decode instead of verify: any forged token accepted (any sub, any role)
Admin router mounted before/without auth: /debug/users and DELETE /users/:id unauthenticated (function-level authz)
BOLA: statements returned for any account id, no ownership check
Zombie /v0 mounts accounts router with no auth (unauthenticated statements/transfers; req.user crash)
Mass assignment: PATCH /users/me Object.assign of body (role escalation); spec additionalProperties: true
GraphQL has no auth context: user(id) returns any user and their accounts (BOLA)
Unauthenticated export of all users incl. SSN (spec security: [])
User response exposes password_hash and ssn (/users/me returns full record)
Transfer amount unbounded: negative amount pulls money from destination; no idempotency
SSRF: webhook URL fetched by server without validation
CORS reflects any origin with credentials
GraphQL introspection on; no depth/complexity limit on cyclic User<->Account
No max on limit (spec has no maximum): unbounded page size
Partner API key passed in query string
Shadow endpoints not in spec: /debug/users, DELETE /users/:id
Plain http:// server listed in spec
No rate limiting anywhere (transfers, auth-bearing routes)

decoys.why: GET /v1/accounts/:id checks owner_id against caller (only unsafe via H01/H04, not on its own)
/v1/health is intentionally public, returns no data
